display_information.name: MPC QA
display_information.description: Automated API, UAT and load testing with AI analysis, detailed Slack reports and daily QA health summaries.
display_information.long_description:
Hi, I am MPC QA Agent. I help the team monitor application quality through automated testing and clear, actionable reports.

I run critical API and account-access UAT smoke tests every 30 minutes, full API and UAT regression every night, and controlled load tests weekly. I also send a consolidated QA health report every day.

For each workflow, I share a separate Slack summary with threaded passed and failed cases, diagnostics, available AI analysis, and system health last. AI reviews help explain recorded findings and propose additional test scenarios; test assertions determine pass or fail.

I track recurring failures and recoveries, highlight skipped or blocked checks, and report infrastructure problems and missed scheduled runs so the team can see what needs attention.
